description: Vervoer- Buslijnen Landsdeel Oost is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.gelderland.nl. The file contains the bus lines in Landsdeel Oost (Province of Gelderland, Overijssel and Flevoland). A number of characteristics have been recorded for each bus line, such as the concession area to which the bus line belongs, start and end destination and direction. Timetable year 2023 (starting 15-12-2022). Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Transport- Bus lines Landsdeel Oost" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
